title: UHI: Continuous Morphology Archetypes for Heat Mitigation Across Cities
description:
Companion code and data for the published article Emekci, S. & Emekci, H. (2026). Beyond local climate zones: Continuous morphology archetypes for heat mitigation across 66 cities. Sustainable Cities and Society, 150, 107814. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.scs.2026.107814

Hosts the full ingest → features → models → archetypes pipeline, Hydra configs, reproducibility notebooks, the published figures, and the harmonised per-patch morphology–UHI table for 66 cities across 15 Köppen climate zones (33,715 one-square-kilometre patches; 33,498 retained after a physical-plausibility screen).

Please cite the article when using the code or the data table; this record exists to archive and version the release. Source repository: https://github.com/hemekci/UHI
